svg.title: Synchronous update time
svg.desc: Current library compared with the previous optimized build at revision 938df92. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. SVG · 12 reshaping lenses: previous median 36.5218 ms, range 34.9943 to 37.5204; current median 35.3731 ms, range 33.282 to 36.3059. SVG · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 64.0621 ms, range 62.9763 to 67.9891; current median 66.3696 ms, range 60.99 to 68.4426. SVG · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 0.463068 ms, range 0.431214 to 0.469492; current median 0.450568 ms, range 0.380208 to 0.484483. WebGL · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 7.88133 ms, range 7.76556 to 8.3444; current median 7.01958 ms, range 6.9029 to 7.12833. 3 trials/build · median of trial means. Async decode and GPU completion excluded
